notionConnector.title: Notion connector — monitoring pack + timeline (read + write)
notionConnector.description: Connector used to (1) READ your monitoring pack — the prompts, brand, competitors, and domain that drive the scrape — and (2) WRITE dated timeline rows back after each run. Your Notion token never reaches this Actor: the Apify proxy injects it server-side.
notionConnector.sectionDescription: The Actor reads your monitoring configuration FROM Notion, scrapes AI engines, and writes the results BACK to Notion. This is the two-way connector loop — without it, you are re-entering prompts by hand every run and exporting CSVs.

slackConnector.title: Slack connector — SoV drop alerts (write)
slackConnector.description: Optional. Dispatches an alert card to Slack when Share-of-Voice drops by more than the configured threshold between runs.

runMode.title: Run mode
runMode.description: Leave as 'analyse'. Set to 'discover' only when connecting a new MCP server for the first time: it prints every tool the connector exposes, then exits without scraping anything.

monitoringDatabaseId.title: Monitoring pack database ID
monitoringDatabaseId.description: The 32-character ID from your Notion monitoring pack database URL. This database has rows with Type (Prompt, Brand, Domain, Competitor) and Value columns. See the README for the template.
monitoringDatabaseId.sectionDescription: Two Notion databases drive this Actor. The monitoring pack decides WHAT to scrape. The timeline stores WHERE results go. Both database templates are linked in the README.

timelineDatabaseId.title: SoV timeline database ID
timelineDatabaseId.description: The 32-character ID from your Notion SoV timeline database URL. Each run appends a row with the date, SoV%, CDS%, RPS, and prompt count.

brandName.title: Brand name (override)
brandName.description: ⚠️ Overrides whatever the Notion monitoring pack says. Use only for testing without a connector, or to force a brand name for a single run. In production, this lives in Notion as a row with Type = Brand.
brandName.sectionDescription: These fields override your Notion monitoring pack. In normal use, leave them empty — your prompts, brand, domain, and competitors all live in Notion. Use these only for testing without a connector.

domain.title: Domain (override)
domain.description: ⚠️ Overrides Notion. Use only for testing.

prompts.title: Prompts (override)
prompts.description: ⚠️ Overrides Notion. Commercial search queries to track. In production, these are rows with Type = Prompt in your Notion monitoring pack.

competitors.title: Competitors (override)
competitors.description: ⚠️ Overrides Notion. Competing brand names to benchmark against.

engines.title: AI search engines to monitor
engines.description: Which AI engines to query. Google AI Overviews is enabled by default and requires NO API key. Perplexity, ChatGPT, OpenAI GPT-OSS on Groq, Groq Compound, and xAI Grok require their respective API keys.

country.title: Target country (e.g. US, UK, DE)
country.description: Two-letter country code(s) (e.g. US or US, UK, DE for multi-country). Leave default for Global (all regions).

language.title: Target language (e.g. en, es, de)
language.description: Two-letter language code(s) (e.g. en or en, es, de for multi-language).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies used for web scraping engines.

perplexityApiKey.title: Perplexity API Key (optional)
perplexityApiKey.description: Recommended for Perplexity AI. Uses Perplexity's official Sonar Pro model with zero Cloudflare block risk.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API Key (optional)
openaiApiKey.description: Required ONLY if 'ChatGPT / OpenAI' is selected under AI engines to monitor.

xaiApiKey.title: xAI Grok API Key (optional)
xaiApiKey.description: Required ONLY if 'xAI Grok' is selected under AI engines to monitor.

groqApiKey.title: Groq API Key (optional)
groqApiKey.description: Powers both 'Groq Compound' and 'OpenAI GPT-OSS on Groq' engine options.

dryRun.title: Dry run — scrape and score but do not write
dryRun.description: Runs the full read → scrape → score pipeline and logs exactly what would be written to Notion and Slack, without touching either. Use this on your first run.

slackChannel.title: Slack alert channel
slackChannel.description: Slack channel for SoV drop alerts. Include the # prefix.

sovDropThreshold.title: SoV drop alert threshold (%)
sovDropThreshold.description: Dispatch a Slack alert when SoV drops by this many percentage points between runs. Set higher to reduce noise from minor variance.

debugMode.title: Detailed logging
debugMode.description: Adds per-query and per-engine detail lines. Useful when a result looks wrong and you want to see why.
